test_title: PYST 38: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been divided into three segments, A, B, C. One of them may contain a grammatical error. Select the segment that contains the error, from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

He is not rich (A) / so he cannot afford (B) / to buy a expensive car (C).
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is "C."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The error lies in the part** 'C.'**
 
• The error in the sentence is a misuse of the indefinite article.
 
• The indefinite article** "an"** should be used before **"expensive"** because **"expensive"** starts with a vowel sound (the 'e' in "expensive").
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 1.

Correct sentence: *He is not rich so he cannot afford to buy **an**__ expensive car.*
